name: antonioancona-website
description: An original personal portfolio designed to communicate Antonio Ancona’s professional profile, selected work, technical range, and contact details. Its information architecture and interaction model take inspiration from [Keita Yamada’s portfolio](https://p5aholic.me/): a restrained, editorial single-page experience with a persistent identity/navigation area and a chronological work index. The visual design, content, and implementation must remain original.
